Outputs quarantine stats (file counts by source). Use --format json or --format
yaml for structured data suitable for a dashboard or other consumers; default is
a human-readable table.

See docs/process/system-health/QUARANTINE_AND_ANALYSIS.md for what goes in
quarantine and the dashboard data story.

Usage:
  zqk.test system quarantine-report [flags]

Flags:
      --verbose   Include per-kind breakdown under hash-duplicates (always included in JSON/YAML)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
